Spec.Name: session_review
Spec.Title: Review a listening session
Spec.Description: Summarise what the human listened to, finished and skipped

Args.Name: since
Args.Description: RFC 3339 start; default 12 hours ago, at most 30 days

Content.Text:
Review the human's recent listening in metamusic. The data below covers 2026-10-06T08:00:00Z to 2026-10-06T12:00:00Z.

```json
{
  "since": "2026-10-06T08:00:00Z",
  "until": "2026-10-06T12:00:00Z",
  "tracks": [
    {
      "track_id": "01900000-0000-7000-8000-000000000101",
      "title": "Synthetic Song",
      "plays": 3,
      "completed": 1,
      "skipped": 1,
      "seconds_heard": 95,
      "last_played_at": "2026-10-06T11:00:00Z",
      "stars": 4,
      "open_comments": 2
    }
  ],
  "totals": {
    "tracks": 1,
    "plays": 3,
    "seconds_heard": 95
  }
}
```

Say which takes the human returned to, which they finished and which they skipped. Ask about the ones that are still unrated. Suggest next steps: add_comment for notes, create_duel between takes that are close, create_draft for a variant. rate_track belongs to the human; do not use it for them.

Never claim to have heard anything. You only know what the data above shows.
